# WhatsApp templates to submit

<!-- Generated by `pnpm templates:doc` from packages/config/src/templates.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Submit each template below in WhatsApp Manager (or your BSP) for the client's WhatsApp Business Account, in both languages.
Use the exact **name**, **category** and **language**; body variables are positional (`{{1}}`, `{{2}}`, …) and quick-reply buttons must be in the order shown.

- **Utility** templates relate to something the lead asked for (their enquiry or appointment).
- **Marketing** templates are follow-ups and review requests; Meta charges more for them and users can mute them.
- Meta may re-categorise a template on review. If it does, update the category in the dashboard so cost tracking stays right.
- Hinglish leads receive the English template; the AI replies in Hinglish once the lead writes back.

| Name | Category | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `il_first_reply` | utility | Instant reply (< 60 s) to a lead who submitted a form or lead ad. |
| `il_followup_day2` | marketing | Day-2 follow-up to a lead who has not replied. |
| `il_followup_day5` | marketing | Day-5 last follow-up before the lead is marked unresponsive. |
| `il_booking_confirmed` | utility | Appointment confirmed (auto-confirm mode, or after staff approval). |
| `il_booking_pending` | utility | Booking request received; waiting for staff to confirm (staff-confirm mode). |
| `il_reminder_24h` | utility | Reminder 24 hours before the appointment. |
| `il_reminder_2h` | utility | Reminder 2 hours before the appointment. |
| `il_no_show_recovery` | utility | Sent after staff mark a missed appointment. |
| `il_review_request` | marketing | Sent after staff mark a visit completed. |
| `il_staff_new_booking` | utility | To clinic staff: a new booking or booking request needs attention. |
| `il_staff_handover` | utility | To clinic staff: a conversation needs a person (handover, emergency, photo or voice note received). |

## `il_first_reply`

- **Category:** utility
- **Purpose:** Instant reply (< 60 s) to a lead who submitted a form or lead ad.
- **Variables:** `{{1}}` = first_name, `{{2}}` = business_name, `{{3}}` = assistant_name
- **Sample values (for Meta review):** `{{1}}` = Priya, `{{2}}` = Smile Dental, `{{3}}` = Asha

**English (`en`)**

```text
Hi {{1}}, thanks for your enquiry with {{2}}! I am {{3}}, their assistant. Can I ask you 2-3 quick questions to help you book a visit?
```

Quick-reply buttons: `Yes, go ahead` · `Please call me` · `Stop messages`

**Hindi (`hi`)**

```text
नमस्ते {{1}}, {{2}} से संपर्क करने के लिए धन्यवाद! मैं {{3}} हूँ, उनकी असिस्टेंट। क्या आपकी विज़िट बुक करने के लिए मैं 2-3 छोटे सवाल पूछ सकती हूँ?
```

Quick-reply buttons: `हाँ, पूछिए` · `मुझे कॉल करें` · `मैसेज बंद करें`
